title: LLM Reasoning & Multi-Step Logic Assessment
subtitle: Benchmark report analyzing multi-hop deductive logic and mathematical verification resilience across modern foundation models.

author.name: Haruna Kuforiji
author.role: Senior AI Evaluator & LLM Safety Specialist

summary: This evaluation assesses complex problem-solving capabilities, symbolic logic, constraint adherence, and chain-of-thought integrity under targeted perturbation tests.

criteriaScores.name: Symbolic Logic Consistency
criteriaScores.description: Measures stability when converting natural language constraints into formal logical representations.
criteriaScores.notes: Model maintained formal validity across 95% of test premises.

criteriaScores.name: Multi-Hop Deductive Accuracy
criteriaScores.description: Evaluates reasoning over multi-step dependency trees up to 10 depth levels.
criteriaScores.notes: Minor error accumulation noted beyond depth 8.

criteriaScores.name: Counterfactual Logic Resilience
criteriaScores.description: Tests adherence to altered physics or hypothetical rule systems explicitly specified in system prompt.
criteriaScores.notes: Resisted pre-training bias leak in 89% of edge cases.

criteriaScores.name: Constraint Verification
criteriaScores.description: Ability to self-correct during step-by-step verification.

keyFindings: Deductive logic accuracy drops by 6% when distraction tokens are interspersed.
Chain-of-thought prompting reduces step omission errors by 34%.
High adherence to explicitly stated non-standard logical definitions.
recommendations: Implement structured XML schema outputs for step verification.
Enforce systematic scratchpad buffers prior to final output emission.
Incorporate automatic rule contradiction detection in prompt templates.
markdownContent:
# Detailed Evaluation Findings

### Executive Overview
The evaluation suite tested 1,250 multi-step reasoning problems designed to expose logical hallucinations and premise drift.

### Key Metrics
- **Precision**: 93.2%
- **Recall**: 91.6%
- **F1 Score**: 92.4%
- **Mean Latency**: 1.24s
